svg.title: Riju links every consequential decision to correction and a human appeal.
svg.desc: Address and identity sources stay editable while Riju draws a branch from consequential decisions to a physical intake slot and a named human reviewer. Ila tests whether the appeal can happen before harm.
svg.text: Page 56, panel 2 · Side view along a consequential-decision path

text.tspan: Riju makes correction and human recourse mandatory
for decisions that affect rights or services.
